extDescription.message: Send links, pages and videos to the Gruzly desktop app.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser.

contextMenuTitle.description: Title of the link, page and video context menu items.

popupUrlLabel.description: Label above the current tab URL.

popupHint.message: Gruzly must be installed. It registers the gruzly:// link on first launch.
popupHint.description: Hint shown at the bottom of the popup.

popupNoUrl.description: Shown when the URL of the active tab cannot be read.

popupOpening.description: Status after the popup hands the URL to the app.

popupError.message: Could not open Gruzly. Check that the app is installed.
popupError.description: Status when the link click failed.
